translate_en|mods/OverTheShoulder/42/med: Over the Shoulder
How far past the back the look reaches

Degrees the edge of the field of view goes past the line straight behind you when looking back. <LINE> 0 stops right at your back, 10 shows a little more of the other side. At night a small margin helps the area straight behind stay visible.
Neck strain from looking back

Holding the look over the shoulder for long makes the neck stiff and sore. A quick glance and the first three seconds are free. <LINE> 1 is the normal rate, 2 twice as fast, 0.5 half as fast. Zero turns neck pain off.
Trip rate looking back while running

How often the character stumbles while running and looking back. A glance of about a second is safe, after that the risk grows over three seconds up to this rate and stays there. Looking ahead again lets it fade. <LINE> 15 is roughly one fall per minute of looking back, 100 is one every ten seconds, 1000 is one a second. Zero never falls.
Trip rate looking back while sprinting
The same for a sprint.
Skills and traits affect trips

The rates above are for a character with no skill. Each level of Sprinting cuts them by 6%%, each level of Fitness by 4%%, so level ten in both removes falls entirely. Graceful halves the rate, Clumsy raises it by half. <LINE> Off, the rates work exactly as set, skills and traits are ignored.
Headgear limits looking back

Helmets, goggles, gas masks and other worn items that narrow the field of view also shorten how far you can see behind you when looking over the shoulder. <LINE> Off, looking back reaches behind you whatever you wear. The normal field of view is narrowed by them as usual.
Double tap holds the look
A double tap of the look key keeps the head following the mouse until the key is pressed again. A tap still glances and holding the key still follows the mouse.
Over the Shoulder now supports multiplayer on its own. Please disable "Over the Shoulder - MP Fix": it replaces part of this mod with an older copy.
